title: Issue with MIME type ('text/plain') when using local echarts.min.js in Streamlit
body:
I am trying to use a local `echarts.min.js` file and have configured my project as follows:

```
project
├── .streamlit/
│   └── config.toml
├── static/
│   └── echarts.min.js
└── app.py
```

The content of `.streamlit/config.toml` is:
```toml
[server]
enableStaticServing = true
```

I added the `CurrentConfig` settings in my Python script:
```python
from pyecharts.globals import CurrentConfig
CurrentConfig.ONLINE_HOST = "/app/static/"
```

I have already set the `Content Type` value to `application/javascript` in the following registry keys: 
- `HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\.js`
- `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Classes\.js`
- `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Classes\.js`

Running `python -c "import mimetypes; print (mimetypes.guess_type('echarts.min.js'))"` in the terminal also returns `('application/javascript', None)`.

However, when running the Python file, the browser console shows the following error:
```
Refused to execute script from 'http://localhost:8501/app/static/echarts.min.js' because its MIME type ('text/plain') is not executable, and strict MIME type checking is enabled.
about:srcdoc:13 Uncaught ReferenceError: echarts is not defined
at about:srcdoc:13:54
```

I tried adding `mimetypes.add_type('application/javascript', '.js')` at the top of my Python file to force the correct MIME type for `.js` files, but the error persists. How can I resolve this issue?

Thank you!


- Streamlit version: 1.52.2
- Python version: 3.11.3
- Operating System: win11
- Browser: Google Chrome 143.0.7499.42

Hi [USER], thanks for you submission!
This is actually expected behavior in that static file serving does not currently support JS files (see documentation [here](https://docs.streamlit.io/develop/concepts/configuration/serving-static-files)). Because it is not an accepted file extension, the handler explicitly overrides the MIME type to `text/plain` for any `.js` file served via `static/`. This decision was made for security reasons.

Switching this to and enhancement request.
